listings.Description: The Data Analyst will be responsible for harnessing data from various platforms, sales, marketing (both online/offline), and consumer channels to provide actionable insights that drive business growth and enhance the sales and optimize shopping experience. This role requires a deep understanding of those channels’ operations and the ability to transform raw data into meaningful visualizations using Microsoft Power BI.
listings.Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Ecommerce, Marketing, or a related field. At least 3 years proven experience in data analysis and reporting using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools (Power Query). Deep understanding of metrics, customer behavior, and online sales operations. Proficiency in Microsoft Access or SQL for data querying and manipulation (but not mandatory). Familiarity with eCommerce platforms, web analytics tools (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics), and CRM systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to derive insights from complex datasets. Excellent communication and presentation skills to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders effectively. Knowledge of statistical analysis and data modelling techniques is a plus. Experience with data visualization best practices and dashboard design. Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced Ecommerce environment.
